articles.summary: First onshore‑piloted ROV operation completed on an offshore rig in Brazil, advancing safer, lower‑risk, and more efficient remote offshore execution.
articles.title: Oceaneering Completes First Onshore‑Piloted Remote ROV Operation on an Offshore Rig in Brazil

articles.summary: Oceaneering has been recognized by the National Ocean Industries Association (NOIA) as a winner of the 2026 NOIA Safety in Seas Awards competition. Oceaneering won the 2026 Safety Practice Award for the company’s High Hazard Task Elimination program.
